name: 左標誌＋右側連結群組（小標題在連結左側）＋直式回到頂端按鈕＋置中小字
desc: 依內容高度的頁尾，左側標誌、右側兩組直向連結（其中一組小標題放在連結左側），最右側一個直式回到頂端按鈕，底部一行置中小字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。頁尾上緣有一條橫跨全寬的分隔線。左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約三分之一是品牌區，只放標誌；右側約三分之二是數欄連結群組，每組是直向排列的文字連結，小標題可省略；有小標題的組，小標題放在連結的左側，和第一個連結同一行對齊。標誌和各組連結的頂端對齊。頁尾最右側、靠近畫面右緣、超出頁面內容寬度處可放一個直式的小型按鈕，按鈕裡上方是箭頭圖示、下方是一行旋轉成直向的小字，高度約和連結群組相同，點擊後回到頁面頂端，沒有時省略。連結群組下方留一段空白後，最下方一列是底部列：一行小字水平置中。
mobile: 左右兩區改為上下排列，全部靠左：標誌在最上方，回到頂端的直式小型按鈕移到標誌右側、靠畫面右緣，直向小字保留；其下是連結群組，改為直向堆疊、全部展開；有小標題的組，小標題改到連結上方，連結往右縮排，連結左側有一條直向分隔線。頁尾上緣的分隔線保留。底部列仍是一行小字水平置中。

en.name: Left logo + right link groups (heading beside links) + vertical back-to-top button + centered small text
en.desc: A content-height footer with a logo on the left, vertical link groups on the right (one group has its heading to the left of its links), a vertical back-to-top button at the far right, and a centered line of small text at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. A divider spanning the full width runs along the top edge of the footer. It is split into left and right areas, aligned to the page content width: the left area, about one third, is the brand block with only a logo; the right area, about two thirds, holds multi-column link groups, each group being vertically stacked text links with an optional group heading; when a group has a heading, the heading sits to the left of its links, aligned with the first link on the same line. The tops of the logo and of every link group are aligned. Optionally place a small vertical button at the far right of the footer, near the right edge of the viewport and beyond the page content width, containing an arrow icon at the top and a line of small text rotated to read vertically below it, about as tall as the link groups; clicking it returns to the top of the page; omit it when not needed. After some space below the link groups, the very bottom row is the bottom bar: a line of small text, horizontally centered.
en.mobile: The left and right areas stack vertically, all left-aligned: the logo at the top, with the small vertical back-to-top button moved to the right of the logo near the right edge of the viewport, keeping its vertical text; below them the link groups stack vertically, all expanded; for a group with a heading, the heading moves above its links, the links are indented to the right, and a vertical divider runs along the left of the links. The divider along the top edge of the footer is kept. The bottom bar remains a line of small text, horizontally centered.
